M06 withdrawal decision mode (ASSUMED).Source: SVB-28: each depositor decides at most once. Hard gates request the segment withdraw fraction of the uninsured gap once; soft gates ratchet a decided probability and request only its increase against the initial uninsured balance. 'repeat' is the legacy per-tick take, which compounded small soft-gate probabilities and set 'already' for everyone on tick 1, so every book drained to the mobile-share cap by minute 30.
